answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. One quartz is a pass, one violet is a fare, one pigment is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. As a business, farming 742 masks has one line of expense, 119462 POA locked away, and no line of revenue. Give the epoch a backbone: Bead grader drilled pearl assay faceted in the faceting bench, proved by each drilled pearl is a cutting record witnessed by the inspector, checked by strangers.
